rules.description: JobProposal uses only its versioned object-specific media type.
ExecutionPlan uses only its versioned object-specific media type.
PlanRegistration uses only its versioned object-specific media type.
The passive source foundation closes profile, member media, manifest media, path, and entrypoint values.
Exact main.mjs bytes are 0 through 262144 bytes inclusive.
main.mjs is strict UTF-8 and does not begin with a UTF-8 BOM.
Newline, Unicode, embedded-BOM, and trailing-newline bytes are retained without rewriting.
SourceManifest v0 is the exact deterministic-CBOR single-member source identity.
Object role, version, member count/path/digest/length, aggregate length, and map order are closed and source-bound.
Live module requests and CommonJS must refuse, but the separately reviewed exact ECMAScript parser boundary is unimplemented.
The passive Oxc engineering-candidate and future enrolled-artifact profile have exact domain-separated fixed records.
A request is exactly 80 through 262224 bytes and carries one copied M1 source without clamping.
Request protocol, method, profiles, media, correlation, length, digest, source profile, and one-frame EOF are closed and bound.
Requests and passive result oracles consume the exact merged M1 byte, identity, HOLD, and SourceManifest fixtures additively.
The fixed 138-byte result binds request, source, artifact profile, closed status/classification, four syntax counts, and one free-CommonJS count.
The daemon and Approval Broker use distinct v1 request, result, process, artifact, and consumer families; cross-role substitution refuses.
Each role-specific request is exactly 216 through 262360 bytes and owns one copied M1 source.
Each fixed 248-byte result binds its exact current role request and complete cleanup disposition.
R1 freezes the inactive resource-policy shape and structural caps while refusing every invented active measurement.
Fixture-only process, artifact, and consumer projections bind one exact role family without enrolling an artifact or consumer.
Historical v0 request/result bytes are never relabeled or accepted by the v1 family.
Raw JSON is at most 2,097,152 bytes.
JSON value depth is at most 32 including the root value.
JSON contains at most the derived 8,193 value nodes.
JSON contains at most 4,096 object members.
One JSON object contains at most 256 members.
JSON contains at most 4,096 array elements.
One JSON array contains at most 256 elements.
Decoded keys and values contain at most 1,572,864 UTF-8 bytes.
One decoded object key contains at most 128 UTF-8 bytes.
One non-source string contains at most 65,536 UTF-8 bytes.
Accept exactly one JSON document with only trailing whitespace.
Accept only shortest-form valid UTF-8.
Reject a UTF-8 BOM.
Reject unpaired UTF-16 surrogate escapes.
Reject duplicate decoded object keys.
Accept only the restricted base-10 integer token grammar.
Accept integers only inside the inclusive cross-language safe range.
Candidate IDs are exactly 16 bytes.
Candidate IDs reject the all-zero value.
SHA-256 digest fields are exactly 32 bytes.
Every 32-byte digest bit pattern is structurally valid, including all zeroes.
Digest width never substitutes for the required nominal role.
Raw deterministic-CBOR payload is at most 65536 bytes.
CBOR data-item depth is at most 8 including the root.
CBOR contains at most 256 total data items.
One CBOR map contains at most 64 entries.
One CBOR array contains at most 8 elements.
Accept only the bounded deterministic-CBOR profile before object decoding.
Raw deterministic-CBOR payload is at most 4096 bytes.
CBOR data-item depth is at most 4 including the root.
CBOR contains at most 33 total data items.
One CBOR map contains at most 16 entries.
One CBOR array contains at most 0 elements.
Accept only the bounded deterministic-CBOR profile before object decoding.
The closed proposal omits unsupported authority instead of accepting false placeholders.
Source paths use the exact relative case-sensitive ASCII grammar.
One source path contains at most 256 ASCII bytes.
One source path segment contains at most 64 ASCII bytes.
A proposal contains at most 32 source file entries.
One decoded source file contains at most 262,144 strict UTF-8 bytes.
The sum of strict UTF-8 source content is at most 1,048,576 bytes.
SourceManifest entries sort by unsigned ASCII path bytes and bind exact content bytes.
The entrypoint exactly equals one source-file key.
Canonical inline JSON has one exact sorted, escaped, non-normalizing byte identity.
Canonical inline-input JSON contains at most 262,144 bytes.
The first slice uses only primary-data input and transformed-json output roles.
Labels contain at most 8 entries.
One label key contains at most 32 ASCII bytes.
One label value contains at most 128 printable-ASCII bytes.
Label values contain only printable ASCII bytes.
The requested runtime profile alias resolves to one active fixed-context entry.
Wall time is requested or defaulted exactly, and ceiling plus one rejects without clamping.
Registration copies, hashes, and stores the exact submitted plan bytes.
Valid objects, identifiers, and digests cannot substitute across nominal roles.
Only the authenticated daemon registration method accepts candidate plan bytes.
Every successful call creates a fresh nonzero registration, including duplicate plan bytes.
The inclusive UInt53 sequence is installation-global and exhaustion fails stale.
Registration requires effectiveNow < expiresAt <= effectiveNow + 300 exactly.
Effective time uses a durable nondecreasing Unix-seconds high-water mark.
Epoch fencing, quarantine, and repair fail closed at their distinct state oracle.
At most 256 unexpired registrations are admitted.
At most 4,096 stored registration records are retained.
Local prerequisite and confirmed-abort failures create no registration or sequence.
Wire registration bytes remain separate from the minimum exact stored record.
ApprovalID accepts only a nonzero exact 16-byte value in its own semantic domain.
AttemptID accepts only a nonzero exact 16-byte value in its own semantic domain.
AttemptNonce accepts only a nonzero exact 16-byte value in its own semantic domain.
ApprovalReference is only the typed local projection of its matching nonzero identifier.
AttemptReference is only the typed local projection of its matching nonzero identifier.
The approval/attempt slice uses only the fixed content-free internal classification vocabulary.
The fixture-only verifier accepts only the exact candidate payload and complete signed/resolved role bindings.
The verifier copies the received envelope and every returned byte slice.
The complete tagged envelope is bounded at 512 raw bytes before ordinary fixture verification, and separately at the calculated closed-candidate maximum below that raw cap.
The embedded canonical payload is bounded at 256 raw bytes before ordinary fixture verification, and separately at the calculated closed-candidate maximum below that raw cap.
The encoded protected-header map is bounded at 128 raw bytes before ordinary fixture verification, and separately at the calculated closed-candidate maximum below that raw cap.
One canonical payload creates one durable usable record; exact replay returns it without mutation.
One transaction consumes one usable approval and creates exactly one immutable attempt.
An indeterminate commit fences mutation until reopen validates one coherent pre-state or post-state.
Exact approval and attempt ceilings reject cap-plus-one without eviction or consumption.
